title: Disability Compensation Date-of-Claim Windows and Telephone Acceptance
content:
These values set how far back a Disability Compensation claim can reach and what may be taken over the telephone. They apply alike at every tier, Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating).

| Item | Value at every tier |
|---|---|
| Intent-to-file validity | 365 calendar days after VA receives the intent to file; a completed claim received within it takes the intent-to-file date as its date of claim |
| Post-separation window | 365 calendar days after release from active duty; an original claim received within it takes the day after separation as its effective date |
| Increase look-back | No more than 365 calendar days before the date of claim, where the increase is factually ascertainable |
| Intent to file recorded through a telephone contact | Accepted |
| Substantive claim (increase, new or secondary condition, individual unemployability) filed through a telephone contact | Not accepted |

**Points of judgement**

- The telephone may protect a date of claim through an intent to file, but it cannot carry the claim itself.
- Hypothetical illustration: an intent to file received on 15 January 2025 stays in effect for 365 calendar days counted from 16 January 2025, so a completed claim received on 15 January 2026 is still within the window and one received on 16 January 2026 is not.
- Hypothetical illustration: for a claim dated 1 July 2025, an increase shown to be factually ascertainable on 1 August 2024 lies 334 days before the date of claim and falls within the 365-day look-back.
